hero_copy: Every piece at Kausar Boutique is checked for quality before it's listed. Gently worn, carefully kept, and priced fairly — because good clothes deserve a second life.
about_copy: Kausar Boutique started as a small effort to give quality ladies clothing a second chance instead of letting it sit unused. Every item is inspected for condition, honestly described, and priced to be fair — not marked up. What you see is what you get, with no surprises when it arrives.
contact_copy: Message us on WhatsApp with the item name and your size — we'll confirm availability, price, and delivery details right there.
footer_note: Kausar Boutique — quality-checked pre-loved ladies clothing.
